text:
Olivia: Heads-up: planning a production Console UI deploy at 15:30 PT today. PR #492 (routing + style tweaks). Can @Maya confirm build artifacts and @Eli handle CDN purge? Need smoke owners and rollback readiness.
Maya: Build passed on CI at 15:10 PT, staging smoke looked good (login/org switch). Assets are fingerprinted; main bundle changed. I'll kick the deploy and watch the frontend rollout. :shipit:
Eli: Will run a staged purge: soft purge for /index.html and soft purge for /static/* at 15:32 PT, then hard purge if we see stale assets. Example Fastly soft purge: 
```
curl -X POST "https://api.fastly.com/service/<SERVICE_ID>/purge/" -H "Fastly-Key: $FASTLY_KEY" -d '"/index.html"'
```
(Using placeholders, will use stored FASTLY_KEY in vault.)
Sam: I'll own smoke checks after deploy: login, org-switch, settings load, billing page, typeahead search. Plan to start at 15:35 PT, report pass/fail in thread. If any blocker, we'll hit rollback.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued by @Maya for 15:30 PT. Deploy ID: deploy-1753245600-UI. Status: scheduled.
Maya: Confirming I will start the rollout at 15:30 PT. I'll monitor console logs and error-rate dashboards. If client JS exceptions > 0.5% for >5m we rollback.
Eli: Rollback plan: use `redwood-deploy rollback deploy-1753245600-UI` (this triggers the previous replica set) or `kubectl rollout undo deployment/console -n prod` as hot fallback. CDN: if rollback, we'll purge again to re-cache previous assets.
Sam: I'll post a short checklist when I start: 1) login 2) org switch 3) billing 4) search 5) key pages load under 1s. I'll annotate results with :white_check_mark: or :x: in this thread.
Olivia: Thanks — @Maya @Eli @Sam please ping here when done. Also check cache-control on index (should be no-cache) and long TTLs on hashed assets. :eyes:
Maya: Confirmed index has Cache-Control: no-cache, hashed assets 30d. Starting deploy in 5.
Sam: standing by. I'll gap-monitor SLOs and report back in 20.
Olivia: Great. If anyone needs to abort pre-launch, post here and tag @Olivia. Good luck everyone :rocket:
